A fixed bottom-right launch button that opens the first chat window. It hides itself once any window is open (the windows carry their own controls).

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/data/ai/ChatFab.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { ChatFab } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/ai";
```
